remarks: Looking for a happy place to live while renovating or needing a short-term rental? You will love living in this bright and charming 3 BR, 1.5 bath updated colonial antique located within walking distance to Georgetown shops and restaurants.  Oversized windows flood this home with natural light while the open floor plan features wide plank floors; a lovely kitchen with granite countertops, and french doors leading to a stone patio overlooking 1.49 acres of beautifully landscaped property, stone walls and native gardens. There is an open living/family room with reading nook and woodstove. A half bath and laundry room complete the main level. The primary bedroom with spacious walk-in closet is located on the upper level, as well as two additional bedrooms and a vintage-style full bath.  Available for rent from January through June 2025 - Landlord may be flexible on dates. This property is on the National Register of Historic Places, part of the Pollinator Pathway Project, and a Certified National Wildlife Habitat.  Conveniently located near Rte 7, shopping, the train and more! Additional interior photos are coming soon.
